description: WRITE tool — creates a product in the caller's Sonar workspace and starts tracking the given app(s). A product is the cross-store unit (one iOS + one Android app, or just one of either). Returns the product id and the Sonar app ids needed by sonar_track_keywords and sonar_track_competitor. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

apps.description: 1-2 store versions: a single iOS or Android app, or one of each for a cross-store product.

items.description: One store version of the product.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "us"). Optional — defaults server-side.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name.description: Product name. Optional — defaults to the first app's name.

name: sonar_create_product
title: Create Product
